name: Wpbingo AI Commander for WooCommerce
author: wpbingo

sections.description:
AI Commander for WooCommerce is an AI-powered WooCommerce product management assistant that lets store owners manage products using natural-language commands.
Manage WooCommerce products, prices, stock, sales, categories, and variations with AI. Supports OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, and OpenRouter.

AI WooCommerce Features:

  • Supports natural-language commands in multiple languages, including English, Hindi, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish and many more.
  • Bulk pricing: increase, decrease, set regular price or sale price (absolute, percent, or fixed amount)
  • Stock management: set quantity, mark in/out of stock
  • Product status: publish, draft, or trash products in bulk
  • Sale campaigns: schedule time-limited sales with automatic start/end and rollback
  • Variation engine: target specific variation attributes (size, color, etc.)
  • Dynamic categories: keyword-based auto-assignment rules synced by cron
  • Dry Run mode: preview every change before it is applied
  • Apply Selected: cherry-pick individual products from a preview result
  • Rollback: one-click undo for any executed command
  • Multi-provider AI with fallback chain and retry logic
  • AES-256-CBC encrypted API key storage
  • Per-user rate limiting on all AJAX endpoints
  • Full command history log with token usage tracking
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
  • Translation-ready (.pot file included)

Supported AI Providers:

  • OpenAI (GPT 5 Mini)
  • Anthropic Claude (Claude Haiku 4.5)
  • Google Gemini (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
  • Groq (OpenAI’s gpt-oss-20b) — free tier available
  • OpenRouter (free tier available)

Third-Party Service Disclosure:

This plugin connects to external AI API services to process your commands. Product data (names, prices, SKUs) is NOT sent to the AI. No customer, order, or payment data is ever transmitted. Please review the privacy policy and terms of service of your chosen provider before use:

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Groq: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/
  • OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/privacy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the wpbingo-ai-commander-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to AI WooCommerce > Settings and enter at least one AI provider API key.
  4. Select your primary provider and optional fallback chain.
  5. Go to AI WooCommerce > Dashboard and start typing commands.
sections.faq:
What is the best AI assistant for WooCommerce?

AI Commander for WooCommerce helps store owners manage WooCommerce products using natural language commands.

Can AI manage WooCommerce products?

Yes. The plugin can update WooCommerce prices, stock, sales, categories, product status, and variations using AI commands.

Can I bulk edit WooCommerce products with AI?

Yes. You can bulk edit WooCommerce products using natural-language AI commands.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. At least one AI provider API key is required. Groq and OpenRouter offer free tiers so you can get started at no cost.

Which languages can I use for commands?

English, Hindi, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish. Other languages may work but are not officially supported.

Is my customer data sent to AI providers?

No. Only your typed command text and a list of your existing category names are sent to the AI provider — no product names, prices, or SKUs are pulled from your store and included in the prompt. No customer, order, or payment information is ever sent.

What happens if my AI provider is unavailable?

The plugin automatically tries each provider in your configured fallback chain. If all providers fail, a clear error message is shown and no changes are made to your store.

Can I undo a command?

Yes. Every executed command stores a full rollback snapshot. Go to AI WooCommerce > Logs and click the Rollback button next to any log entry.

Does the plugin work with variable products?

Yes. The variation engine uses a dedicated index table for fast attribute-based lookups and supports targeting by size, color, or any custom attribute.

Will this slow down my store’s front end?

No. All operations run in the WordPress admin only. Large bulk operations (1000+ variations) are processed as background jobs via Action Scheduler.

What data is removed when I uninstall the plugin?

All plugin data is fully removed on uninstall: 4 custom database tables, all settings and encrypted API keys, scheduled cron jobs, and transients. Your WooCommerce products are not affected.
